buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Freshness points fairly clearly to Ayala. Ayala has 17 games on the legs over 14 days (1 match) against 101 for Burillo (5). In the past week Burillo has played 2 matches, Ayala 1.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: A slight edge to Ayala on motivation and pressure. Ayala is playing at home in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and the crowd should help with the big points.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: Burillo gets a slim nod on conditions. Burillo has 17 matches on Clay in the last 90 days, Ayala only 4, so the adjustment period is shorter.

bottom_line: The model leans Burillo at 77%; agreement across the three signals is 39/100 (conflicting signals). The biggest risk is fitness & fatigue: Ayala is fresher (17 vs 101 games in 14 days).
